info.title: vision_processor GUI host
info.description:
The GUI host's control API: the shared vision.yml document, its state, and what the host's
sockets hear. Every error is JSON, `{"error": code, "message": text, "issues": [...]}`; clients branch on
`error`. Request bodies must be JSON and unknown keys are rejected.

## Live updates

`/ws` is a WebSocket carrying topics. Send `{"action": "subscribe", "topic": "..."}` (or
`unsubscribe`); each message is `{"topic": "...", "data": ...}`. A new subscriber gets the latest value at
once. A message the host can't act on is answered with an error and the connection stays open. Each topic's data
is the body of a REST endpoint documented here:

| Topic | Same as |
| --- | --- |
| `config.state` | `state` in GET /api/config |
| `network.state` | GET /api/network |
| `alerts.state` | GET /api/alerts |
| `wrapper_packet.out` | GET /api/geometry |

get.summary: Opens a camera's live video WebSocket
get.description: JSON status (once a second) and format (codec and size) messages, and binary fragmented MP4 segments ready for a MediaSource SourceBuffer in sequence mode. A new viewer starts at the last keyframe.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Full (every frame, the default) or keyframes (about one a second, for grids).

schema.description: Full (every frame, the default) or keyframes (about one a second, for grids).

id.description: Stable while the problem lasts, for keyed lists.

params.description: The facts the alert is about, named per code.

ConfigCalibration.description: A locked SSL_GeometryCameraCalibration, published in place of whatever the camera's vision_processor last sent.

fieldHash.description: Identifies the field dimensions the calibration was solved against; a mismatch means the field changed since locking.

ConfigCamera.description: One vision_processor instance, keyed by camera_id (its position on the field), not by which machine runs it.

config.description: Overrides Defaults, same config.yml layout, deep-merged.

configPath.description: A host-local config.yml to regenerate from this document for a vision_processor on the same machine. Empty for remote instances.

display.description: How the GUI shows this camera's video. Never rendered.

ConfigCameraStatus.description: Everything about a camera derived from the document plus the live network state -- never stored.

live.description: The latest calibration received from the network (proto field names), whether or not one is locked -- what "Lock" would store.

liveResolution.description: The image size the live calibration was solved at, [0, 0] if unknown.

ConfigChange.description: One leaf-level difference between two documents. Before or After is nil when the value was added or removed. Lists (e.g. line_corners) are compared as a whole, not element by element.

path.description: In vision.yml's spelling (field.field_width), JSONPath in the JSON document's (field.fieldWidth). In both, cameras[N] is the camera with camera_id N, not a list index.

ConfigDisplay.description: Orients a camera's video in the GUI to match the field, since a camera can be mounted at any angle.

competitionField.description: A match setup, with a game controller, rather than casual lab use. The GUI keys height choices by team and raises missing setup to errors; vision_processor doesn't read it.

defaults.description: Uses vision_processor's own config.yml layout (camera:, geometry:, color:, thresholds:, ...) and applies to every camera.

host.description: Settings for this GUI host alone; no vision_processor reads it.

teams.description: Overrides robot heights by team. Shown in the GUI only for now: vision_processor still looks heights up in bot_heights_file by game controller team name.

ConfigDriver.description: What a camera driver does with the camera: block (src/driver/*.cpp).

selectsBy.description: How the block picks a device: "id", an index in the SDK's camera list, or "path", a device or file path.

whiteBalanceProfiles.description: Separate OUTDOOR and INDOOR auto profiles.

ConfigEffectiveConfig.description: Every setting of one camera, resolved.

settings.description: By dotted config.yml path, as in Schema.

ConfigEffectiveSetting.description: One setting as camera's vision_processor runs it.

known.description: False for a key the schema doesn't describe: it's written to config.yml, but nothing the host knows of reads it.

ConfigExternalState.description: Describes a change made to the file on disk by something else. Changes are what loading it would do to the working document.

ConfigFile.description: A YAML file beside the one the store edits.

current.description: The file the store loads from and saves to.

readOnly.description: Files (rulebook presets, no write permission) can't be saved over.

ConfigHost.description: Settings that only mean something on the machine running the GUI host, such as its network interface names.

ConfigInterfaces.description: Chooses which network interfaces the host's sockets use.

auto.description: (the default when unset) lets the host pick. Skip is then kept only so switching back to manual restores it.

skip.description: Names interfaces not to use when choosing manually.

ConfigLayout.description: How the field is split between cameras.

cameraCount.description: The number of regions the field is split into (vision_processor's geometry.camera_amount). It can exceed the number of cameras, leaving some regions uncovered.

ConfigRange.description: A control's suggested span and step.

ConfigResponse.description: The working document plus the store's state.

ConfigSchema.description: Describes everything a client needs to edit vision_processor settings without reading the C++: served as GET /api/schema.

ConfigSeed.description: The human-picked calibration starting point: the four field line corners in image pixels, and the image resolution they were picked at. Resolution [0, 0] means unknown (e.g. imported from a legacy config.yml).

goalSideMarker.description: Records which corner-picker marker (1-4) was chosen as the goal-side corner. vision_processor never reads it.

slot.description: The slot the corners were picked for. Moving the camera to another slot makes them stale. Nil for corners saved before slots were recorded.

ConfigSetting.description: One key of vision_processor's config.yml layout, as the defaults block and each camera's config hold it.

default.description: Vision_processor's own fallback for an unset key, nil when there is none (derived) or it depends on other keys (camera.path).

minimum.description: Bounds the host enforces, inclusive unless Exclusive.

range.description: A sensible span for a control, narrower than the bounds. The value itself may be anything within the bounds.

ConfigSettings.description: vision_processor's config.yml layout, as GET /api/schema describes it. A key it doesn't read is kept but raises an unknown_setting warning.

cam_id.description: Written by the host from the document; don't set it.

height.description: Takes effect when vision_processor restarts. Unit: px.

width.description: Takes effect when vision_processor restarts. Unit: px.

min_reference_force.description: Read only by the GUI host.

debug_stream_interval_ms.description: Reloaded live, within a second. Unit: ms.

camera_amount.description: Written by the host from the document; don't set it.

line_corners.description: Written by the host from the document; don't set it.

max_line_segment_angle.description: Takes effect when vision_processor restarts. Unit: °.

clipping_tolerance.description: Reloaded live, within a second. Unit: mm.

geometry_tolerance.description: Takes effect when vision_processor restarts. Unit: mm.

min_cam_edge_distance.description: Reloaded live, within a second. Unit: mm.

resampling_factor.description: Reloaded live, within a second. Unit: ×.

max_bot_acceleration.description: Reloaded live, within a second. Unit: m/s².

min_tracking_radius.description: Reloaded live, within a second. Unit: mm.

ConfigSlot.description: A camera's place in the layout: its camera_id out of the camera count, which together decide the region it covers.

ConfigState.description: The store's status as the GUI sees it.

changes.description: What saving would write: disk -> working.

external.description: Set while the file on disk differs from what was last loaded or saved.

ConfigTeamOverride.description: A team's robot height when it isn't (rightly) in the height table: another table entry's (Name), or a custom Height. Neither set means a custom height not entered yet.

ConfigTeams.description: Overrides robot heights by team. Keyed by the game controller's team name, as vision_processor's height table is, so an override follows its team through a color switch (the game controller swaps the whole team record, name included, between colors).

byColor.description: Each color's height off a competition field, where there's usually no game controller to name the teams.

ConfigWarning.description: One problem worth surfacing on a camera, with a stable code the frontend can key UI (e.g. a "rescale corners" button) off.

DetectionsSource.description: One camera_id heard from one address.

GeometryFieldConfig.description: The editable subset of SSL_GeometryFieldSize -- everything except FieldLines/FieldArcs (generated, never hand-edited) and the fields that live elsewhere (Calib is runtime state, not static config).

GeometryOptionalLinesConfig.description: OptionalLines with concrete bools instead of pointers -- an API request/response always supplies all four, so there's no "missing" case to represent here the way there is when parsing a hand-edited YAML file.

HttpjsonErrorBody.description: The body of every non-2xx API response.

issues.description: Lists each problem separately for CodeInvalid.

path.description: The file to load, on the host.

MulticastInterface.description: One local network interface as the Network page shows it.

address.description: Its first IPv4 address, if any; Broadcast that subnet's broadcast address.

autoUse.description: What automatic selection decides; AutoReason why it doesn't use the interface.

usable.description: Means up, multicast capable, and with an IPv4 address: the least a socket needs to use it at all.

used.description: Whether the host's sockets use it under the current selection.

MulticastStatus.description: An endpoint's address and what it has heard there.

mode.description: How the receiver was opened: "multicast" joined the group, "port" listens on the port for anything sent there (broadcast, or unicast to this host).

problem.description: Why the sockets aren't fully open, if they aren't.

NetworkState.description: Each socket's address and what it has heard, plus the host facts the Network page's presets and notes need. Served as network.state and GET /api/network.

PutConfigRequest.description: A whole working document and the revision it's based on.

revision.description: The revision the document is based on; a stale one is a 409.

RefereeState.description: What the GUI shows about the current match.

heard.description: When the last referee message arrived, nil if none has.

heights.description: The whole table, team name to height in mm.

meanHeight.description: Vision_processor's height for a team not in the table, until a known team has played; MaxHeight is the tallest in the table, which it uses for its field extent checks.

RefereeTeam.description: One side of the current match.

height.description: The team's robot height from the table, nil when the team isn't in it.

RevisionResponse.description: Answers a config write with the revision it left the working document at.

SaveAsRequest.description: Saves the working document to another file.

path.description: The file to write, on the host.

revision.description: Must be the current one; a stale one is a 409.

SaveRequest.description: Saves the working document at a revision.

force.description: Overwrites vision.yml even if it changed on disk since it was loaded: the "overwrite disk" answer to the external-change prompt.

revision.description: Must be the current one; a stale one is a 409.

V4LDevice.description: One way to name a capture device.

kind.description: "by-id" (follows the camera), "by-path" (follows the USB port), or "node" (/dev/videoN, which can change when devices re-enumerate).

name.description: The driver's name for the device, e.g. "UC70: UC70".

WrapperPacket.description: An SSL_WrapperPacket from the league's ssl_vision_wrapper.proto, as canonical protojson (camelCase field names, enums as strings).

field.description: SSL_GeometryFieldSize: the field template, its lines and arcs.
